facts.fact: 分兵入神城：Cosima 领剑（争执无用——Cosima 是她的弱点）；Ulshära 屏退全部守卫（护弱势街区与 portal house）——踏 dais 开门「The wards will recognize my blood……I will not stand by while Phos unleashes his terror across the stars. If I fall, do not hesitate. Do what you must.」；Divine City=空旷广场横贯全城、外墙环「见过更好世纪的」土语建筑、巨庙以病光照亮弃城；「Risha 已封北门。分头堵其余。Noctan, with me.」
facts.anchor: The wards will recognize my blood

facts.fact: 西门琴火：Angelica+Cosima 上 watchtower 城齿——Rorik 率军团踏甲而来；Cosima「I may not be as good as Koshi with one of these, but at least I know how to shed blood with it.」；琴贴肩「如两块拼图咬合」——「If they were going to win, she needed to abstain from Deia's rage to maintain control. It was the only way she could keep Cosima safe.」；一曲 Common Conquest（Cardica 歌剧《四骑士》）——火瀑落地成墙「Try to get past that, you bastards.」

Rorik 破火：他咧嘴喝彩「Very nice! Powerful! I like it!”」——弹指光盾成拱门、率兵穿火而入；「Shit shit shit」；额上痒转刺痛——「Control……Don't give her the satisfaction. But what was the point of control if it meant risking Cosima's safety? In the end it always came back to power——the never-ending need for more. Anger made her strong. Fear made her weak. This was not a fight she could win with her violin, but with the weapon she'd stolen from her god.」
facts.anchor: Very nice! Powerful! I like it!”

facts.fact: 东门谈判：Dante 影伏——Faün 率三十余翼军团；「You tried and failed to compel him……He is laced with the poison that is his god.」「I was caught by surprise. This time I'm prepared.」；Zenith 闪回「就算长獠牙利爪、眼睛永久变色、皮肤成鳞——即便落得 Baron Alma 的下场——也不许一根羽毛漏进 Vitae」「Very well. But I have another trick.」；影线成「神经网」缠住军团脚踝
facts.anchor: You tried and failed to compel him

facts.fact: Ulshära 劝降与醒悟：亲劝 Faün「There's still time to rethink your position.」——「Always the negotiator……You have always been too eager to please and too easy to swindle.」；她控诉「你恨 Varrick 用你，于是用我——偷走我与 Oskar 造福穷人的 Device 去喂 Phos 的野心。从来不是 Varrick 拉你的线——it is him.」「Nobody pulls my strings.」「Then you delude yourself.」；「你不过是个祭品！他送你去 Vitae 送死！」——violet 不确定一闪——「And you should have been dead long before now.」；「Dante saw the moment Ulshära's disappointment struck. When she finally realized that peace would never be possible with conquerors.」；母训「You can never please everybody——为最需要的人做你能做的」；「It's strange. But somehow I think I understand the Sunslayer's intentions now.」
facts.anchor: When she finally realized that peace would never be possible with conquerors.

facts.fact: 「Die」反噬：lightsbane cables 缚 Faün（第二 Device）——Dante 灌力入网——Baron Alma 画面回闪「Man and demon, merged into one hideous design」——对军团喝「Die.」——「But none of them fell. Because of his hesitance, the compulsion didn't take. It backfired.」——剧痛如反手耳光、七窍渗血跪地；Azideh「You miserable fool——你说不计代价，却仍被自己的恐惧锁着」；Faün 撕缆「The rat got caught in its own trap.」；Ulshära 护他迎战——「They are both mine.」；Nox 翻 notepad——血涂土之 glyph 按地——影柱裂地——Taesia 到场「Seems I didn't get an invitation to this little get-together.」

姐弟刑场重逢：Faün 狂喜「At last I'll avenge all the sacred warriors」被挥手隔开「I'll get to you in a minute.」；Ulshära 亮条件「我肩上的羽已毁——若他试图附我，你可动手。Not a moment sooner.」「Noble of you. But I'd rather not keep another risk around.」；Dante 挡路「Run. Go help the others.」——第一次正眼看妹妹（更瘦更冷、星云翻涌的眼）「And yet——还是那个要他讲睡前故事的女孩、为厨房偷来的点心道谢的女孩、信他每一句傻话的女孩」；「Not even a hello first?” Taesia asked. “Nice horns.」「You little shit.」；西门被破——「We have this side covered. Go.」；抓肩「Vonlins 先——门一开他们直扑 Vitae。Don't subject Bee to that. Not again.」「They call you the Sunslayer. You may as well earn that title.」——「她于阴暗中烧红——全领域的怒火都比不过那一抹」
facts.anchor: Not even a hello first?” Taesia asked. “Nice horns.

facts.fact: 影分身迎战：影分身战军团、本尊战 Faün（刀光非人速）；Azideh「她看起来需要帮忙吗？何况你的机会已经浪费了」——「She'd always been skilled at dueling, but this……This was what it looked like to not be afraid of power or its costs.」
facts.anchor: to not be afraid of power or its costs.
